project.note.title: Happy Booth joins NOTE GROUP for its new brand identity launch
project.note.coverCaption: The Happy Booth photo corner at NOTE GROUP’s new brand identity launch.
home.jobs.note.p1: NOTE GROUP officially unveiled its new brand identity, marking a new chapter after four years of growth and development.
home.jobs.note.p2: The ceremony introduced the new look alongside NOTE GROUP’s direction for its next phase, covering both its brand image and delivery capabilities: consulting, planning, installation, operation and maintenance of advertising locations.
home.jobs.note.p4: With the message “BUILDING THE FUTURE”, NOTE GROUP reaffirmed its direction based on four core values: Credibility – Professionalism – Efficiency – Pioneering vision, improving service quality and supporting the growth of its clients and partners.
project.note.experienceText: Happy Booth accompanied the celebration with a photo corner for guests and frames featuring NOTE GROUP’s new identity. Guests took photos together, captured their smiles and brought home a keepsake from the event.
project.note.framesText: Brand colours, the logo and the message “A new look – Building the future” appeared on the photo frames, connecting the photo experience with the ceremony. Group prints captured the shared joy as NOTE GROUP introduced its new look.

project.note.ctaText: Share your brand identity and event plans so Happy Booth can help prepare a fitting photo corner.
